items.title: JJ Johnson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: So I don’t know which came first, going abroad with Basie or going abroad with this quintet with Oscar Pettiford and entertaining the servicemen in the Far East.

ctx.x: Yeah, you’re right. You're right. Pettiford on bass. There was no piano. There was no keyboard player because we were going in places where there was no piano – in the field, entertaining servicemen. So we had guitar, who was . . .

Keeter. Right. Right. Right. There it was. There's the quintet, right there. So I don’t know which came first, going abroad with Basie or going abroad with this quintet with Oscar Pettiford and entertaining the servicemen in the Far East.
